attempts.diagnosis: SearchRecursive lacks a precondition bounding i and j to valid indices of a. Without `0 <= i <= j <= |a|`, the sortedness precondition and the postconditions can index a out of range, the body access `a[m]` can be out of range, and the termination measure `j-i` can be negative when `i > j`. SearchLoop already has this bound, but SearchRecursive does not.
